source: The confidence-weighted net worth in BiggerPockets' Personal Financial Statement: each asset is rated 1-4 for how sure you are it is worth what you say, and the statement shows a weighted total beside the plain one.
confidenceNote: The weights are a convention chosen to make the four ratings mean something in dollars — 'guaranteed' counts in full, 'probably zero' not at all. There is no research behind 0.85 or 0.5.
note: Keyed by asset.confidence. An asset with no rating counts in full in the plain total and is EXCLUDED from the weighted one, which the room says out loud. D-064.
